book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli kameune fooŋ metam nadisukilitihinit fotokiyemguk
Judame heki’walaŋ hinamuni Pentikos yoyagiŋ, nai tubune me Jesu nadisukilitimiyagiŋ hogohogok buŋa noŋgoŋ yotmaaŋ kubugoŋ gineŋ bopneeŋ ikiŋ.
Ila nadilune nemek niŋ kunum foloŋ fifiŋ dabugoŋ fotoguk, fooŋ buŋa wooŋ yot bop tiŋa hakiŋneŋ fooŋ gigilitŋiŋdi tuwot tubune ila
kalune kudumebem nabugoŋ mintaaŋ tawaaŋ wooŋ mehinek ikiŋ indigoŋ yehiwehemikuk,
kaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi welehik maaneŋ fotokooŋ yehitubu-lodaune mede mu nadiyagiŋ u yogiŋ.
Kaŋ Judahi Youkudip Mede tagimneeŋ keleyagiŋ adi yokwet wapuhi kwetkwet haliuguk indigoŋ tuwot bugiŋ, buŋa Jelusalem uŋoŋ hatigiŋ.
Ala mede wapum unduŋ totubune nadiŋa metam buŋa bopneeŋ metam nadisukilitihinitdi mede uŋgoniŋ uŋgoniŋ fee hinek yobune nehi’walaŋ medehik molomolom gineŋ nadiŋa
yabune beweniŋgoŋ hinek tuguk. U yabuŋa yogiŋ, “Mewoi i Galilihi
iŋgoŋ dediŋ tiŋa indi’walaŋ mede unduŋ yoiŋ?
Indi adi Patiya, Midiya, Ilam, eŋ Mesopotamiyahi, tiŋa Judiya, Kapadosiya, Pontas, Esiya,
eŋ Filigiahi tiŋa Pamfiliya, Isip, Libiya kwet wapum maaneŋ Sailini ilune yokwet magimagineŋhi, tiŋa Loma, Kilit, eŋ Alabiyahi.
Indi Judame tiŋa me noli Bepaŋ’walaŋ feknit mokit heki Judahi’walaŋ titiŋhik keleŋ tam, iŋgoŋ dediŋ tiŋa inde’walaŋ medenik molomolom indigoŋ hinek Bepaŋdi nemek momooŋ tinimguk wendok yobu nadiyam?”
Unduŋ yoŋa boho tiŋa kiyonadi tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Kei, maŋgoŋ tiŋa indiŋ toiŋ!”
Kaŋ nolidi yenimpekit tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Mewoi i ime fafaŋeŋ naŋit tiŋa mede unduŋ hinek toiŋ.”
Pitadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kigili mede folooŋ mintaune mebi yodakaleguk
Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Aposel heki adi pilali yali Pitadi metam indiŋ yenihautaguk, “Judame heki eŋ metam Jelusalem itowiiŋ, hidi magi kametnadi tineŋ kaŋ nemek i mintalakdok mebi hanindakalewe nadineŋ.
Metam i ime fafaŋeniŋ mu naŋit, i 9 kilok haniŋ.
Nemek polofet Joeldi koom youkuk u agaŋ mintalak.
Indiŋ youkuk, ‘Bepaŋdi nai wapum dulalune indiŋ tibaat yoguk,

content.text: “Nu Uŋgoniŋ Munabuline u metam hogohogok ugoloyembene wapmihihiye adi nu’walaŋ kigili medene yohautaneeŋ eŋ mekuyahi adi nemek lihine gineŋ nabugoŋ mintayembu kaneeŋ, eŋ me kilitihi adi lihine tineeŋ.
Na’walaŋ tipilapilaye-metamneye adi maaŋ nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Munabuli ugoloyembaat kaŋ nu’walaŋ kigili medene yohautaneeŋ.
Eŋ foloniŋ kunum foloŋ kudi tibaat eŋ kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ nemek mu mintadok u tibe mintaneeŋ, naŋgat mintawaak kaŋ kudup daune mupmuk gouyeniŋ lowaak,
eŋ mele mambip tibaak kaŋ muyakip naŋgat nabugoŋ gimindawaak kaŋ Wapum’walaŋ nai wapum saŋiniŋnit tiŋa holiholiŋenit mintawaak.
Unduŋ mintaune nebek niŋ Wapumdi tubulodadok ninadiwaak adi kedem tubulodawaak.”’

content: “Juda me heki, nu hanimbe nadineŋ, Jesu Nasaletniŋ adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ kudi mebimebi mehinekdi mu titiŋ u agaŋ miŋgoŋ tubune kaŋ nadigiŋ,
eŋ koom nadihebet tuguk u agaŋ Jesu hidi kohohik foloŋ kameune me kadakaniŋ titiŋdi hehitubu-lodaaŋ koloŋdabek foloŋ ulukumuŋgiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ kumuŋ diniŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ tuwot moŋ dokti Bepaŋdi kumuŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ ulatifooŋ tubupilakuk.
Wondoktiŋa Dewitdi Jesudok indiŋ yoguk,

content.text: ‘Nu Wapum helemahelemaŋ hebetne foloŋ yalune kalat, eŋ adi yamaiŋgoŋ hatilak doktiŋa nu kadakaniŋdi mu nehitubu-kadakawaak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa mede nadifo foloŋ yolat, nu me fafaŋeŋ moŋ, kumuŋ tibaat iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ adi nehitubu-lodaaŋ kumuŋ kwetneŋ mu binabaak. Adi nehitubu-pilalaak doktiŋa Bepaŋdok nadinadi hogok hatilat.
Bepaŋ, du’walaŋ kwanai-mege bikabune kwetfoloŋ meyotneŋ iŋoŋ mu bitakawaak.
Hatihati fofooŋ diniŋ talik agaŋ nanindidimeguŋ doktiŋa hebeke foloŋ nadifo wapum hinek tibaat.’

content: “Notneye, nu Dewit papanik’walaŋ mede hebiniŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Adi agaŋ kumumbune wenefulagiŋ kaŋ adi’walaŋ sitŋiŋ u agaŋ kanadiyam ale indiŋ yolat.
Adi polofet ala Bepaŋdi mede yofafaŋe timiŋa yalakiŋiŋ niŋdi Mapme Wapum mintaaŋ Dewit ne ikuk undugoŋ ilaak yoŋa nindapmaŋ tuguk.
Kaŋ Dewit adi kougoŋ Bepaŋdi nemek tibaak u kanadiŋa Kilisto’walaŋ pilapilatdok indiŋ yoguk,

content.text: ‘Adi meyotneŋ mu bikabune hatibaak eŋ folooŋ bom gineŋ mu hali bitakawaak.’

content: “Bepaŋ adi Jesu agaŋ kaipmuŋ tubupilakuk kaŋ indi mede biyagoŋ wondok sigiyakadi tam.

Adi agaŋ Bepaŋdi tubupilali nagilooŋ kohoŋ didimeniŋneŋkade kameeŋ mede yofafaŋe tuguk undugoŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli mimbune kahileguk. Kahileeŋ kamenimbu folak doktiŋa nemek kaŋ nadiiŋ yoŋ adi Jesudi kamenimilak.
U Dewit kunum foloŋ loguk adi mu tuguk, adi yadi indiŋ yoguk,

content.text: ‘Bepaŋnedi nu’walaŋ Wapumnedok indiŋ niŋguk, “Kohone didimeniŋneŋkade iŋandiŋ ileŋ
kaŋ memikgeye hogohogok kayo uloloŋ unduŋ kayoge falipmeŋ yapmewaat.”’

content: “Judahi metam, hidi indiŋ hinek nadineŋ. Hidi Jesu ulukumuŋgiŋ iŋgoŋ me uŋakoŋ Bepaŋdi Wapum eŋ Kilisto kambiyatnimguk.”
Metam feedi wele tubutakale tubune Imeyout tiyemgiŋ
Pitadi unduŋ yenimbune metamdi mede u nadiŋa dediŋ titiŋdok yoŋa Pita eŋ Aposel noli yeninadigiŋ. “Notniye, indi dediŋ tinim?”

Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Pitadi yeniŋguk, “Hidi hide, molomolom hinek kadakaniŋhik sigilulum tiyemiŋa buŋa Jesu Kilisto wou gineŋ Imeyout tubune Bepaŋdi kadakaniŋhik kedem tumolokuhamuŋa Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli ugolohambek.
Gigit woŋ adi hiditok tiŋa wapmihihiyedok eŋ metam neeŋ kweetniŋ hatiiŋ, nebek Bepaŋnikdi netok gigit kutiyenilak aditok yofafaŋe tugukdi tilak.”
Pitadi mede fee yeniŋa yenindokooŋ mede indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi me kadakaniŋ tiiŋ u mu yehikeleŋ taneeŋ. Adi kougoŋ Bepaŋdi kibikoŋ yembaak.”
Unduŋ yobune metam feedi mede u nadisukilitiŋa buŋa Imeyout tigiŋ kaŋ melenai wondok metam feedi Jesu’walaŋ kayoŋbop gineŋ yehitomboyoulu yokunathik 3 tausen tuguk.
Metam unduŋ tiŋa Aposel heki’walaŋ mede nadigalikaaŋ buŋa bopneeŋ welekubugoŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ ninadiŋa Dumuŋ nayagiŋ.
Metam nadisukilitihinit adi welekubugoŋ hinek tiŋa hatigiŋ
Unduŋ tiŋa Aposel hekidi kudi fee hinek tubune metamdi u yabuŋa nadiune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk.
Metam nadisukilitihinit adi tomboyoula welekubugoŋ tiŋa bopneeŋ welesiloŋ foloŋ bomboŋhik kibikibi tiŋa hatigiŋ.
Bomboŋhik noli tuwadok boiune metam nolidi buŋa tuwaune muneeŋ moŋgola dane tagiŋ.
Helemahelemaŋ Siloŋyotneŋ bopneyagiŋ eŋ yohineŋ noŋgoŋ bopneeŋ welesiloŋ tiŋa nanaŋe nadifo foloŋ naaŋ
Bepaŋ niutumbayagiŋ. Kaŋ metam nolidi yabuŋa nadiune utumba tuluguk. Unduŋ tubune helemahelemaŋ Wapumdi metam gitipmuhi yanagila yehitomboyoutuguk.

footnotes.text: Judahi’walaŋ titiŋ adi indiŋ hatuguk doktiŋa unduŋ yeniŋguk. Adi 9 kilok haniŋ hogohogok ninadi kwanai tagiŋ. Nai undineŋ ime fafaŋeniŋ mu nayagiŋ.
